[[Jermahzeh]] is a [[pet tamer]] found standing south of the shrine just as you exit [[Basalt Grotto]].

==Locations==
*[[Desolation]]
**{{NPC location|Joko's Domain}}

==Dialogue==
{{dialogue-stub}}

''"Ahai, <character name>. My name is Jermahzeh [Pet Tamer]. I am renowned for my animal training prowess with nearly every creature under the sun. I'm always on the hunt for new and exotic beasts to add to my collection. Do you have any creatures you'd like to part with?"''
:'''"What do you do with the animals you collect?"'''
:''"I'm a simple soul, happiest when I can feel the earth under my feet and the sun warming my skin. Training and earning the trust of beasts both great and small brings me more joy than all the riches in Vabbi could provide. Rest assured that each creature under my care will either remain in my collection as a trusted companion or be gifted to one with a similar interest."''
::'''"I'd like to think it over some more."'''
:'''"{{x}}No, I don't. Good luck with your hunting."''' (Leave)
